operation.project.progress.code:
with self.db.transaction() as conn:
    rows = conn.execute('SELECT p.*, COALESCE(c.total, 0) AS task_count, COALESCE(c.done, 0) AS completed_task_count FROM "projects" p LEFT JOIN (SELECT "project_id" AS parent_id, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = %s) AS done FROM "tasks" GROUP BY "project_id") c ON c.parent_id = p.id ORDER BY p.id', ('completed',)).fetchall()
result = []
for row in rows:
    total, completed = row["task_count"], row["completed_task_count"]
    row["progress_percent"] = int(round(100 * completed / total)) if total else 0
    result.append(row)
return result
notes: progress = completed tasks / all tasks per project; the fields are ADDITIVE to the graph schema (the graph defines no aggregate schema)
